cases.name: adds updates and deletes files atomically

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-old
+new
*** Delete File: remove.txt
*** Add File: added.txt
+created
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: a.txt
@@
-old
+new
*** Update File: b.txt
@@
-missing
+changed
*** End Patch

expect.error:
[b.txt]: Could not find a close enough match in b.txt. Closest match (22% similar) at line 1.
No files were modified — sections apply atomically.

cases.name: Add File does not overwrite an existing file

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: a.txt
+replace
*** End Patch

expect.error: Cannot create a.txt: file already exists. Use *** Update File to modify it in place.

args.input:

*** Delete File: a.txt
*** Add File: a.txt
+new
